description.text: This is the catalytic domain of class A beta-lactamases [[cite:PUB00059638]]. It is closely related to Beta-lactamase, [pfam:PF00144], the serine beta-lactamase-like superfamily, which contains the distantly related [pfam:PF00905] and PF00768 D-alanyl-D-alanine carboxypeptidase.

PUB00059638.title: Structure of PBP-A from Thermosynechococcus elongatus, a penicillin-binding protein closely related to class A beta-lactamases.

representative_structure.name: STRUCTURE OF BETA-LACTAMASE PRECURSOR, S70A MUTANT, AT 120K
